Here's What's Happening

Over the past 2 years, a new AI skill has let people build their own software and apps without knowing how to code. It's called "Vibe Coding."

Most entrepreneurs think the money is in building software and selling it. The real money is in distribution: the ability to get that software in front of buyers and get them to pay.

Here's what's happening right now. More and more people are coding software and watching it flop because they're missing one key piece: how to market it and drive new customers to buy.

Proof You Can Check Yourself

Go to Facebook or Reddit right now and search "Vibe Coding." Jump into any of those communities.

You'll see a ton of people cloning tools or building their dream software, then flipping out when they realize they have zero idea how to get anyone to see it or pay for it. They're posting the same question every day:

"How do I get users?"
